deals.metaGraphCaption: 🎃 HALLOWEEN NIGHT AT AURORA ROOFTOP BAR 👻 Get ready for a night to remember! Join us on October 31st from 7 PM to midnight for spooky vibes, beats by our DJ, exclusive signature cocktails and delicious food specials — all with a view above the city. 🕸️ Dress up & get rewarded! Come in your best Halloween costume and enjoy a complimentary shot on us. The best costume of the night will win a special surprise! Gather your friends, dress to impress and celebrate Halloween with us above the rooftops of Vienna. 📍 Aurora Rooftop Bar October 31st | 7 PM – Midnight Are you ready for a little fright and a lot of fun? 🦇 #AuroraRooftopBar #HalloweenVienna #HalloweenParty
